author: Battlefront3
quote: There are simply far too many negative things to say about this game. It is arguably the biggest disappointment in the history of video games. what will be remembered most are the shameful scores given by journalists—a corrupt press that brings disgrace to the art form of video games. In no world does this game deserve a 99. It is a sign of a corrupt era where money takes precedence over every single moral value. GTA 6 is a disappointment on every level—in terms of gameplay, plot, and many other elements.Above all, it will be remembered for the "woke" propaganda within the game, as well as the normalization of digital-only releases and a €100 price tag. It’s a disgrace.
